title: Toddler Group: Monday
description:
St John's Toddler Group is for children aged 0-4 (pre-school) and their parents and carers. We aim to be a safe and happy place where parents/carers and children can play and make friends. We look forward to welcoming you and your little one(s). 

Please book your place online only one sign up is required per family
£2 per family | Payable online or on the door 

Bookings will open the day before the event i.e. on Sunday for the following Monday and on Tuesday for the following Wednesday. 

By registering online you are reserving a play place but, due to the high demand, we cannot guarantee your place past 10.20am. If for any reason you can no longer attend a session, please cancel your place, using the cancellation function in the confirmation email. Spaces are limited so please free up your place if you no longer need it so that another family can attend.
address: St John's Church, Court Oak Road, Harborne, Birmingham, B17 9TG

title: Warm Welcome
description: Warm Welcome is a friendly space for everyone to come along, stay warm and enjoy some time together. There's free tea, coffee, hot chocolate and toast, as well as plenty of opportunity to chat, meet new people, play games and get creative with crafts. Whether you're looking for some company, a chance to relax or simply somewhere warm to spend a little time, everyone is welcome.
address: St John's Church, Court Oak Road, Harborne, Birmingham, B17 9TG

title: St John's English Conversation Group
description:
Looking to improve your English in a relaxed and friendly setting? Our English Conversation Group is a welcoming space for people of all backgrounds to practise speaking English, build confidence, and make new friends. If you're hoping to refine your English and already have Level 2 speaking skills, this group could be a great fit for you.

Join us for informal chats, friendly discussions, and a supportive environment where you can grow at your own pace. If you'd like to know more, contact Stella—or simply come along and see if this group is right for you!
address: St John's Church, Court Oak Road, Harborne, Birmingham, B17 9TG

title: Celebrate Recovery
description:
Celebrate Recovery is a 12 step recovery program helping anyone with a hurt, habit or hangup.

Meeting every Monday evening throughout the year, The evening consists of a large group meeting for some teaching and then smaller gender specific groups for sharing and encouragement. There is no need to book – we welcome anyone just to turn up.

Doors open at 7:45pm for refreshments and the meeting starts at 8pm. This group is only for those aged 16 and above.

More information can be found on the website below.

Contact Nathan Burden for more information.

This program is suitable for over 16's.
address: St John's Harborne, B17 0DT

title: Parentalk Parenting Course
description:
If you're a parent of young children and would like to chat about the joys and challenges of family life, we'd love you to join us on Tuesday mornings from 10am–11.30am. Coffee and biscuits are provided, and toddlers and babies are very welcome!

We'll be exploring a range of topics through the Parentalk series, including:

It's Not Just Me - 6 Oct
Love Them And Let Them Know - 13 Oct
It's Good To Talk - 20 Oct
Boundaries and Battles - 3 Nov
Parenting With Elastic - 10 Nov
Belonging - 17 Nov

If you have any questions, feel free to email Kate at katediwakar@stjohnsharborne.org.
We're looking forward to seeing you there!
address: St John's Church, Court Oak Road, Harborne, Birmingham, B17 9TG

title: Parent & Baby Group
description:
St John's Parent and Baby group is for children aged 0-12 months and their parents and carers. The group offers a great chance to meet other new parents in the area. We will also have some parenting advice from Barnardo's children charity ranging from tips for weaning your baby, dealing with teething and care for their teeth and reading with your baby, as well as access to help for postnatal depression. 

We have made every effort to keep you and your baby as safe as we can:

  • The group is limited to 20 babies with a parent
  • All surfaces and toys will be cleaned before use and baby-safe anti-bacterial wipes will be available for your use. 
  • Please let us know if you cannot come for any reason. 

 

We are looking forward to seeing you soon!
address: St John's Church, Court Oak Road, Harborne, Birmingham, B17 9TG
